property_summary: After any successful call to executeBatchDeposit, the contract's stored lastUnpauseTimestamp equals the current block.timestamp only if at least 15 minutes elapsed since the previous successful call; the mutant allows lastUnpauseTimestamp to advance on the second call even when the elapsed time is shorter than the cooldown.
change_summary: Replace 15 minutes with 0 in the cooldown require, letting executeBatchDeposit proceed much sooner after the last unpause.
